title: Symbolic Temporal Supervision of LLM Agents Using Contracts
abstract: arXiv:2609.18128v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents augmented by tools can automate complex, multi-step tasks, such as web navigation, code generation, and workflow orchestration, by acting on external systems through tool calls. However, hallucinations, distributional instability, and adversarial manipulations in LLMs, and the irreversible consequences of certain tool calls can lead to harmful outcomes. Existing safeguards either grade recorded trajectories post hoc with stochastic LLM judges or block unsafe actions one call at a time, and no single deterministic artifact supports both roles. We present ContrAgent, a contract-based framework for symbolic temporal supervision of LLM agents. ContrAgent captures an agent's behavior as a sequence of tool calls and formalizes it as a trace over a fixed set of checkable predicates. translated_title: 基于契约的LLM智能体符号化时序监督
translated_abstract: 配备工具的大型语言模型（LLM）智能体可以通过工具调用作用于外部系统，从而自动化复杂的、多步骤的任务，例如网页导航、代码生成和工作流编排。然而，LLM中的幻觉、分布不稳定性以及对抗性操纵，加上某些工具调用的不可逆后果，可能导致有害结果。现有的保障措施要么使用随机的LLM评判者事后对记录的轨迹进行评分，要么一次只拦截一个不安全动作，没有任何单一的确定性工件能够同时支持这两种角色。我们提出了ContrAgent，一个用于LLM智能体符号化时序监督的基于契约的框架。ContrAgent将智能体的行为捕获为工具调用序列，并将其形式化为固定可检查谓词集合上的轨迹，然后使用有限轨迹上线性时序逻辑（LTLf）中的假设-保证契约来指定所需行为。每个契约……
tldr: 该论文提出了ContrAgent框架，通过有限轨迹线性时序逻辑（LTLf）中的假设-保证契约，对LLM智能体的工具调用行为进行符号化时序监督，以应对幻觉和不可逆工具调用带来的有害后果。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes ContrAgent, a contract-based framework that provides symbolic temporal supervision of LLM agents' tool-call behaviors using assume-guarantee contracts in LTLf, addressing harmful outcomes caused by hallucinations and irreversible tool calls.
